s: A company's key performance indicator for its retail website is that customers can sign in and complete a checkout at any time. Real-user traffic is very low at night, so problems are discovered only in the morning. The company wants to test the full sign-in and checkout flow every 5 minutes from several Regions and be alerted when the flow breaks. Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries that script the sign-in and checkout flow, run them every 5 minutes in several Regions, and create CloudWatch alarms on the canary success percentage.
Add Amazon CloudWatch RUM to the website and create alarms on JavaScript errors reported by browsers.
Create Amazon Route 53 health checks against the website's /health URL from several Regions and alarm when a health check fails.
Query the Application Load Balancer access logs with Amazon Athena every 5 minutes and alarm when the number of 5xx responses increases.

w.y: Synthetics canaries are scripted, scheduled tests (Node.js, Python or Java, with browser automation through Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium) that follow a user journey and publish success and duration metrics, so they test the flow even when no real users are online.

o.A: Correct. A scripted journey on a schedule, from several Regions, with alarms on success.
o.B: RUM measures real users. At night there are almost none, which is the problem being solved.
o.C: A health check fetches one URL (optionally matching a string). It does not sign in or complete a checkout.
o.D: Logs only show what real users did, and there is little traffic at night. A broken flow that returns 200 would also be missed.
